title: Read resources from an absolute manifest dependency in a launched JAR
summary: A fresh java -jar launch now reads the asset from an absolute manifest entry. Replacing that JAR at the same path changed the bytes from amber to cobalt, with a same-named amber decoy outside the classpath.

change.description: Classpath wildcard resolution now recognizes an existing dependency JAR when a launcher manifest gives its absolute filesystem path.

notes: The child checked the loaded Spring resolver origin. Both revisions also read the one amber resource through a relative Class-Path entry.
